'''2011 Bespin Regionals Mitch LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitch]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' QMC
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
